purpose: Downstream release gate for opponent-family mixture shift after historical family calibration and action-bound causal closure.
scope_exclusions: fresh game execution or seed custody

math.family_effect: minimum leave-one-independent-seed-out mean after mirrored-seat clustering
math.family_seat_floor: minimum declared own-cash and margin mean for every opponent-family by candidate-seat slice
math.uncertainty: box-constrained total-variation ball around integer hosted family counts
math.optimizer: exact rational greedy mass transport for a linear objective
math.uniform_family_reference: equal-family reference independent of observed hosted counts
math.leave_one_family_out: equal-family stress after omitting each opponent family in turn

peer_assist.disposition: Consolidated into the earlier durable claim to preserve one release decision surface.
